say:3:1720426001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我看到它们了！

say:4:1720426002:0.text: You dive forward to grab the monkey by the scruff just as it's about to leap, while your other hand shoots up and snatches the parrot out of the air the second it spreads its wings.
say:4:1720426002:0.source_cn: 你眼疾手快，飞扑上前，左手一把抓住了正要跳起的猴子的后...
say:4:1720426002:0.male: You dive forward to grab the monkey by the scruff just as it's about to leap, while your other hand shoots up and snatches the parrot out of the air the second it spreads its wings.
say:4:1720426002:0.female: You dive forward to grab the monkey by the scruff just as it's about to leap, while your other hand shoots up and snatches the parrot out of the air the second it spreads its wings.

say:5:1720426003:1.text: Whew... that took some work, but we've got them.
say:5:1720426003:1.source_cn: 呼……费了一番力气，终于抓住这两个家伙了！
say:5:1720426003:1.male: Whew... that took some work, but we've got them.
say:5:1720426003:1.female: Whew... that took some work, but we've got them.

say:7:1720426005:0.text: Squawk! Angry! Let go! Let go of the great parrot king!
say:7:1720426005:0.source_cn: 哔！生气！哔！放了！鹦鹉！大王！

say:8:1720426006:1.text: Sulk all you like. You're done running.
say:8:1720426006:1.source_cn: 生气也没用，这下你们可逃不掉了。

say:9:1720426007:1.text: Let's take them back to the guard.
say:9:1720426007:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我们把它们交给那位守备军吧。
say:9:1720426007:1.male: Let's take them back to the guard.
say:9:1720426007:1.female: Let's take them back to the guard.
